intro.title: Feel at home, on Dimaro's square.
intro.text: A garnì with a welcoming character and a relaxed, intimate atmosphere. Rooms upstairs, breakfast and the bar on the ground floor: everything you need to switch off, in the heart of Val di Sole.

stay.title: Simple and wooden, the Trentino way.
stay.text: Double, triple and quadruple rooms with exposed beams and wooden furniture, private bathroom with bath or shower, TV and Wi-Fi. Bed and breakfast or half board.

breakfast.title: Good mornings start here.
breakfast.text: A warm wood-panelled room, croissants and pastries at the counter: the right way to start a day on the slopes or the trails.

bar.title: Our bar, open to everyone.
bar.text: On the ground floor is Bottega Moderna, the garnì's bar: a coffee in the morning, a break after skiing, a drink in the evening. Open every day, also to those not staying with us.

exp.title: Val di Sole, right outside the door.
exp.text: In winter, skiing at Folgarida-Marilleva and Madonna di Campiglio. In summer, the cycle path, rafting on the Noce and the trails of two nature parks. You choose the day, we take care of the rest.

where.title: On the square, in the heart of Dimaro.
where.text: We are on Piazza Centrale in Dimaro Folgarida, a few minutes from the Folgarida-Marilleva lifts and on the Val di Sole cycle path. Madonna di Campiglio and the Stelvio and Adamello Brenta parks are close at hand.

final.title: The best dates go first.
final.text: Send us your dates: we'll reply with availability and price. The enquiry is not binding.

meta.title: Things to do in Val di Sole, winter and summer | Garnì della Locanda
meta.description: Skiing at Folgarida-Marilleva and Madonna di Campiglio, the Val di Sole cycle path, rafting on the Noce, trekking in the parks. All a few minutes from Garnì della Locanda.

hero.title: A valley that never stands still.
hero.lead: Dimaro Folgarida is the ideal base: slopes in winter, rivers and trails in summer. You choose the day, we take care of the rest.

items.title: Folgarida-Marilleva
items.text: The lifts are a few minutes from the garnì. From here you can ski all the way to Madonna di Campiglio in the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta.

items.title: Passo del Tonale
items.text: High-altitude slopes and the Presena glacier, for reliable snow all season long.

items.title: Cross-country and snowshoes
items.text: Cross-country loops and snowshoe trails through the valley's woods, for those who prefer silence to speed.

items.title: Val di Sole cycle path
items.text: The cycle path runs through Dimaro and follows the Noce river along the valley. Perfect for families, e-bikes too.

items.title: Rafting on the Noce
items.text: The Noce is one of Europe's most popular rivers for rafting and kayaking, with routes for beginners and experts.

items.title: Trekking in the parks
items.text: Stelvio National Park and Adamello Brenta Nature Park: trails, mountain huts and alpine lakes for every level.

base.title: The day is yours. The rest is ours.
base.text: Back from the slopes or the trail, stop at the bar on the square and head up to your room. No car needed.
